fields.Name: T082 - Permissions User Access
fields.Description: Opens the Permissions app User Access tab once, then exercises its bespoke aggregation surface (report loads for current user, switch-user reload, domain accordion expand/collapse) in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T218-T220.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the 'Permissions' application; it opens on the 'User Access' tab in the left nav. Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) access-report-loads — confirm the 'User Access Report' surface renders: a 'User:' picker dropdown at top (pre-selected to a user, since the current user is auto-selected on load) and either a 'N permissions across M domains' summary with collapsible domain accordion panels below, OR a clear empty-state card; (2) access-switch-user — open the 'User:' dropdown and select a DIFFERENT user, and confirm the report responds (a brief 'Loading permissions...' state may appear, then the domain groups / summary count update for the newly selected user, or a valid 'No permissions' empty-state); (3) access-domain-expand — find a collapsible domain accordion panel (domain name + icon + count badge); if the pre-selected user shows no domains, pick a user with permissions (an admin user is a good bet); click a panel header to expand it and confirm it reveals a permissions table with Resource / Type / Actions / Effect (Allow/Deny) columns, then click again to collapse it (a valid 'No permissions' empty-state is an acceptable success if the user genuinely has none). Keep going until all sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: access-report-loads
checkpoints.instruction: User Access Report renders for the auto-selected user
visualCriteria: The User Access Report renders with a 'User:' selector dropdown at the top, a user pre-selected, and either a '...permissions across ...domains' summary with domain accordion panels OR a clearly labeled empty-state card

checkpoints.name: access-switch-user
checkpoints.instruction: select a different user and see the report reload
visualCriteria: Selecting a different user in the 'User:' dropdown triggers a reload (loading indicator and/or updated summary/accordion content) and the report content reflects the newly selected user — either updated permission domain groups OR a valid 'No permissions' empty-state

checkpoints.name: access-domain-expand
checkpoints.instruction: expand/collapse a domain accordion panel to reveal its permissions table
visualCriteria: A domain accordion panel with a name, icon, and count badge is visible, and clicking its header expands it to show a permissions table (Resource / Type / Actions / Effect columns) that can be collapsed again — or a valid 'No permissions' empty-state is shown
